machine.name: GOV15_break-glass-emergency-override
machine.description: Break-glass emergency override: an attested, distinct principal with clean keys requests it, the break-glass coordinator opens the emergency epoch and queues its ratification, the emergency permits under a mandatory incident trail, post-hoc quorum and parity ratify it, and the lease (the stale lane) or a tamper revokes it.

inputSemantics: req_epoch_swap (binary; fact: scripts/approve-domain.sh deploy / domains/deployments (epoch request); partial): a rule-epoch swap is requested
gate_source_slsa_attested (binary; fact: provenance attestation (verify-build-provenance.py today; SLSA/in-toto new); partial): Sources and builds are attested
reserved: lane_in_workflow (lifecycle frame lane 2; the asset is in its workflow)
reserved: lane_re_pinned (lifecycle frame lane 3; a frame document has been re-pinned (T16))
reserved: lane_approved (lifecycle frame lane 4; approved by a distinct human principal)
reserved: lane_rework (lifecycle frame lane 5; rework requested)
reserved: lane_step_running (lifecycle frame lane 6; a step is running)
reserved: lane_stale (lifecycle frame lane 7; the head is STALE (continuation TTL or lease expired))
emergency_open (binary; aigov-break-glass-coordinator completion via aigov.gov15.break-glass-coordinator.completion): the emergency epoch is open and its lease started
ratification_queued (binary; aigov-break-glass-coordinator completion via aigov.gov15.break-glass-coordinator.completion): a W2 ratification frame is queued
coordinator_failed (binary; aigov-break-glass-coordinator completion via aigov.gov15.break-glass-coordinator.completion): the agent's step failed
lane_quorum_integrity_ok (binary; fact: keyring Source: re_pki CRL plus signer keys, org units, dwell; partial): signer keys clean, diverse, dwell met
lane_principal_distinct (binary; fact: lifecycle extension: approver != preparer and not an agent (T15); new): the acting principal is distinct from the preparer and human
quorum_valid (binary; fact: GOV06 verdict, carried by the frame; new): the approval quorum for this frame is valid
gate_3of3_parity (binary; fact: RealityEngine_CI regression run report (parity stages); partial): C++, LSP and Scala agree 3-of-3 on the candidate

governance.escalationPolicy: AIGOV::Governance Steward -> AIGOV::Approval Quorum; agents never resume an approval continuation (T15)
